messages:
sara.lin: quick thread — planning to onboard komodo-8b-r2 (edge-tuned). Can someone run a smoke + throughput sweep? p50 target <80ms on p4d, tail <300ms. Also capture KV cache hit % and a flamegraph. I put baseline requirements in the doc: https://redwood/internal/onboarding/komodo :eyes:

james.k: I can run smoke now. Which quant profile? nf4 or int8?

sara.lin: nf4 for default, please also run int8-compat for fallback. seq len 512 and 1024. batch sizes 1,4,8. Use chat workload + long-context test (1k tokens). thanks :pray:

james.k: copying command to bench runner
```bash
bench run --model=komodo-8b-r2 --quant=nf4 --seqs=512,1024 --batches=1,4,8 --workloads=chat,longctx --kvcache=enabled --runs=6 --tag=onboard-komodo-2026
```

bench-bot: scheduled run onboard-komodo-2026 on p4d-1 (pool=dedicated-smoke). Job id 1715001234.42. ETA 35m. :robot_face:

mike: added dashboard route /models/komodo-8b-r2/edge and enabled p99 latency alert threshold = 450ms. will link results when ready.

bench-bot: run complete. Summary:
- nf4 seq512 batch1 p50=68ms p95=180ms p99=320ms throughput=120 req/s
- nf4 seq1024 batch1 p50=95ms p95=240ms p99=420ms throughput=60 req/s
- int8 seq512 batch1 p50=72ms p95=190ms p99=340ms throughput=110 req/s
KV cache hit: cold-start penalty ~1.8x, steady-state hit=74% at batch4
Artifacts: s3://perf-artifacts/onboard/komodo-1715001234/{flame.html,trace.json,logs.tar.gz}

arya: quick look — seq1024 p50 exceeds 80ms on p4d for nf4. But batch1 seq1024 might be expected. Can we try kernel tuning / enable async-kv? small tweak: runtime flag --kv-prefetch=1

james.k: re-running nf4 seq1024 batch1 with --kv-prefetch=1 and enabling continuous-batching=on, will kick off as job 1715001234.43

bench-bot: scheduled run 1715001234.43 on p4d-1. ETA 20m.

bench-bot: run complete. nf4 seq1024 batch1 (kv-prefetch=1 + cont-batch) p50=78ms p95=195ms p99=360ms throughput=65 req/s. Artifact: s3://perf-artifacts/onboard/komodo-1715001234/retune/

sara.lin: great, looks like perf within target for nf4 with small runtime tweaks. Action items:
- eng-runtime: add kv-prefetch default for komodo-8b-r2 in onboarding profile (james)
- eng-platform: publish canary route next week (mike)
- deprecate int8 fallback until further QA (arya)

sara.lin: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
